{{Quote|Bring back some supplies. Food. Water. Soap so I can wash the filth of that prison off me.|[[Revan/Legends|Revan]], after being rescued from his cell on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]|<ref name="The Old Republic: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Soap''' was a substance used to wash bodies and clothes. Many kinds of soap existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[Ewok soap]], [[Trillium soap]], [[Shadowroot soap]], and [[Sludir soap]].
